issues.description: Method getTotalNumberOfStudents(): the problem statement UML (problem_statement.md) declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() with return type String, but the reference implementation in the solution repository (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) implements getTotalNumberOfStudents() returning int. The template repository does not provide a concrete signature (it contains a TODO for this method), leaving students to choose which artifact to follow. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected return type and lead to implementations that disagree with the reference solution or test expectations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Recommended: update the UML in problem_statement.md so the method signature reads getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (change the String to int at the UML line and any textual references that imply a String return). Alternatively, if a String return type is intentionally desired, update the solution and template guidance so getTotalNumberOfStudents() returns a String (e.g. Integer.toString(total)) and update the UML and description to match. Prefer aligning to int to reflect numeric semantics and the current reference implementation.
